notes: μή and οὐθέν stand in different clauses (*have not love* / *I am nothing*), so neither rule 41 nor rule 59 is engaged and neither negator is emptied; the check is the clause boundary, not the distance between tokens.

*the gift of* is folded onto the anarthrous προφητείαν as rule 7 helpers completing that noun's own English, which is LUK.8's shape under rule 103's licensing test rather than its added arm; the head stays on *prophecy*, *gift* being the generic completion (rule 17).
ὥστε takes the two-word English introducer *so as* headed on *so*, and the infinitival *to* stays with μεθιστάναι under rule 61, no preposition governing the construction.

All three articles before quantified nouns are unrepresented under rule 23: the ASV writes *all mysteries*, *all knowledge*, *all faith* with no determiner, and the quantifier's own word is not the article's to take.
